reason: Most of my clients live in WhatsApp, and I'm not moving thirty of them onto a Telegram bot because I want them to. My routine is messy but it works, and my real problem is chasing late and missing receipts, not typing them in.
objection: It looks built for one business tracking its own spending, not for a bookkeeper with a separate chat for each client. Nothing here chases a client who hasn't sent anything, and I'd still have to forward everything over from WhatsApp myself.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked inside the WhatsApp chats I already have, put each client into their own sheet, and nagged clients about missing receipts before month end.
